			(function() {
				// Get the current domain for API URL
				const currentDomain = window.location.origin;

				const statusUrl = currentDomain + '/api/v/1/profile/info/';
                				
				// Cache key and TTL (12 hours)
				const CACHE_KEY = 'tsc_user_profile_data';
				const CACHE_TTL = 12 * 60 * 60 * 1000; // 12 hours in milliseconds

				function hasValidProfileData(data) {
					return data && data.techSmithId;
				}

				async function fetchProfileFromApi() {
					const response = await fetch(statusUrl, {
						credentials: 'include',
						mode: 'cors'
					});

					let data;
					try {
						data = await response.json();
					} catch (e) {
						throw new Error('API request failed: invalid JSON');
					}

					if (!response.ok) {
						console.warn('Profile API returned ' + response.status, data);
						return data || null;
					}

					return data;
				}

				async function getUserProfileData(retryCount = 0) {
					try {
						// Check localStorage cache first (only use cache if it has valid profile data)
						const cached = localStorage.getItem(CACHE_KEY);
						if (cached) {
							const { data, timestamp } = JSON.parse(cached);
							const now = Date.now();
							if (now - timestamp < CACHE_TTL && hasValidProfileData(data)) {
								return data;
							}
						}

						const data = await fetchProfileFromApi();
						if (data === null) return null;
						
						// If user logged out, clear cache
						if (data && data.SignedIn === false) {
							localStorage.removeItem(CACHE_KEY);
							return data;
						}

						// Only cache when we have meaningful profile data (avoids caching empty response right after login)
						if (hasValidProfileData(data)) {
							localStorage.setItem(CACHE_KEY, JSON.stringify({
								data: data,
								timestamp: Date.now()
							}));
							return data;
						}

						// Profile not ready yet (e.g. right after login): retry once after a short delay
						if (retryCount === 0) {
							await new Promise(function(r) { setTimeout(r, 1500); });
							return getUserProfileData(1);
						}

						return data;
					} catch (error) {
						console.error('Error fetching user profile data:', error);
						return null;
					}
				}

							e.preventDefault();

							// Clear cache synchronously (localStorage.removeItem is synchronous)

							// Now navigate to sign-out URL

		var sw = document.querySelector('.language-switcher');

			<script>
			window.dataLayer = window.dataLayer || [];
			dataLayer.push({
				'content_group': '',
				'language': 'en',
			});

			// User info - fetched from API and cached in localStorage
			(function() {
				// Get the current domain for API URL
				const currentDomain = window.location.origin;

				const statusUrl = currentDomain + '/api/v/1/profile/info/';
                				
				// Cache key and TTL (12 hours)
				const CACHE_KEY = 'tsc_user_profile_data';
				const CACHE_TTL = 12 * 60 * 60 * 1000; // 12 hours in milliseconds

				function hasValidProfileData(data) {
					return data && data.techSmithId;
				}

				async function fetchProfileFromApi() {
					const response = await fetch(statusUrl, {
						credentials: 'include',
						mode: 'cors'
					});

					let data;
					try {
						data = await response.json();
					} catch (e) {
						throw new Error('API request failed: invalid JSON');
					}

					if (!response.ok) {
						console.warn('Profile API returned ' + response.status, data);
						return data || null;
					}

					return data;
				}

				async function getUserProfileData(retryCount = 0) {
					try {
						// Check localStorage cache first (only use cache if it has valid profile data)
						const cached = localStorage.getItem(CACHE_KEY);
						if (cached) {
							const { data, timestamp } = JSON.parse(cached);
							const now = Date.now();
							if (now - timestamp < CACHE_TTL && hasValidProfileData(data)) {
								return data;
							}
						}

						const data = await fetchProfileFromApi();
						if (data === null) return null;
						
						// If user logged out, clear cache
						if (data && data.SignedIn === false) {
							localStorage.removeItem(CACHE_KEY);
							return data;
						}

						// Only cache when we have meaningful profile data (avoids caching empty response right after login)
						if (hasValidProfileData(data)) {
							localStorage.setItem(CACHE_KEY, JSON.stringify({
								data: data,
								timestamp: Date.now()
							}));
							return data;
						}

						// Profile not ready yet (e.g. right after login): retry once after a short delay
						if (retryCount === 0) {
							await new Promise(function(r) { setTimeout(r, 1500); });
							return getUserProfileData(1);
						}

						return data;
					} catch (error) {
						console.error('Error fetching user profile data:', error);
						return null;
					}
				}
				
				// Detect sign-out link clicks and clear cache
				function setupSignOutDetection() {
					// Use event delegation to catch dynamically added sign-out links
					document.addEventListener('click', async function(e) {
						const signOutLink = e.target.closest('.sign-out-link-2');
						if (signOutLink) {
							// Prevent default navigation so we can clear cache first
							e.preventDefault();
							e.stopPropagation();
							
							// Clear cache synchronously (localStorage.removeItem is synchronous)
							localStorage.removeItem(CACHE_KEY);
							console.log('Cache cleared:', CACHE_KEY);
							
							// Now navigate to sign-out URL
							const signOutUrl = signOutLink.getAttribute('href');
							if (signOutUrl) {
								window.location.href = signOutUrl;
							}
						}
					});
				}
               				
				// Setup sign-out detection
				setupSignOutDetection();

				async function pushUserDataToDataLayer() {
					const profileData = await getUserProfileData(); console.log('profileData raw:', profileData);

					// Build dataLayer object with only non-empty values
					const userDataLayer = {};

					// If user is signed in and we have profile data
					if (profileData && profileData.techSmithId) {
                        
						// Get TechSmithId (user_id)
						if (profileData.techSmithId) {
							userDataLayer.user_id = profileData.techSmithId;
						}
						
						// Get hashed email
						if (profileData.hashedEmail) {
							userDataLayer.user_email = profileData.hashedEmail;
						}

                        // Get hashed first name
                        if (profileData.hashedFirstName) {
							userDataLayer.first_name = profileData.hashedFirstName;
						}

                        // Get hashed last name
                        if (profileData.hashedLastName) {
							userDataLayer.last_name = profileData.hashedLastName;
						}
					}

					// Only push to dataLayer if we have at least one value
					if (Object.keys(userDataLayer).length > 0) {
						window.dataLayer = window.dataLayer || [];
						dataLayer.push(userDataLayer);
					}

                    console.log(userDataLayer);
				}

				// Execute the function
				pushUserDataToDataLayer();
			})();

(function() {
	var translatedLangs = {"en":"https:\/\/www.techsmith.com\/","de":"https:\/\/www.techsmith.de\/","fr":"https:\/\/www.techsmith.fr\/","es":"https:\/\/www.techsmith.es\/","ja":"https:\/\/www.techsmith.co.jp\/","pt-br":"https:\/\/www.techsmith.pt\/"};
	var availableTranslations = {"de":"true","en":"true","es":"true","fr":"true","ja":"true"};
	var currentLanguage = "en";

	var supportedCountries = ["ES", "FR", "DE", "PT", "JA", "MX", "AR", "CO", "CL", "PE", "VE", "EC", "GT", "CU", "BO", "DO", "HN", "PY", "SV", "NI", "CR", "UY", "PA", "GQ", "AO", "MZ", "GW", "TL", "CV", "ST"];
	var spanishCountries = ["ES", "MX", "AR", "CO", "CL", "PE", "VE", "EC", "GT", "CU", "BO", "DO", "HN", "PY", "SV", "NI", "CR", "UY", "PA", "GQ"];
	var portugueseCountries = ["PT", "BR", "AO", "MZ", "GW", "TL", "CV", "ST"];

	function applyBanner(linkUrl, linkText) {
		var sw = document.querySelector('.language-switcher');
		var link = document.querySelector('.language-switcher .language-link');
		if (!sw || !link) return;
		link.setAttribute('href', linkUrl);
		link.textContent = linkText;
		sw.style.display = '';
		var header = document.querySelector('.tsc-header-wrapper-redesign');
		if (header && sw.offsetHeight) {
			header.style.top = sw.offsetHeight + 'px';
		}
	}

	function onIpInfoResponse(response) { console.log(response);
		var link = document.querySelector('.language-switcher .language-link');
		var sw = document.querySelector('.language-switcher');
		if (!link || !sw) return;

		var country = response && response.country;
		if (!country) { 
			console.log('no country'); 
			return; 
		}

		// Show banner when user's country matches a language and they're not already viewing that language.
		// Only require a target URL (translatedLangs); allow linking to language root if current page has no translation.
		if (spanishCountries.indexOf(country) !== -1 && currentLanguage !== 'es' && translatedLangs['es']) {
			applyBanner(translatedLangs['es'], 'Spanish');
		} else if (country === 'FR' && currentLanguage !== 'fr' && translatedLangs['fr']) {
			applyBanner(translatedLangs['fr'], 'French');
		} else if (country === 'DE' && currentLanguage !== 'de' && translatedLangs['de']) {
			applyBanner(translatedLangs['de'], 'German');
		} else if (portugueseCountries.indexOf(country) !== -1 && currentLanguage !== 'pt' && translatedLangs['pt-br']) {
			applyBanner(translatedLangs['pt-br'], 'Portuguese');
		} else if (country === 'JP' && currentLanguage !== 'ja' && translatedLangs['ja']) {
			applyBanner(translatedLangs['ja'], 'Japanese');
		} else if (currentLanguage !== 'en' && supportedCountries.indexOf(country) === -1 && translatedLangs['en']) {
			applyBanner(translatedLangs['en'], 'English');
		}
	}

	function initBannerDropdown() {
		var wrapper = document.querySelector('.language-switcher .tsc-dropdown-menu-wrapper');
		var trigger = document.querySelector('.language-switcher .tsc-dropdown-menu-trigger');
		if (!wrapper || !trigger || wrapper.dataset.dropdownBound === 'true') return;

		wrapper.dataset.dropdownBound = 'true';

		trigger.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
			e.preventDefault();
			e.stopPropagation();
			wrapper.classList.toggle('active');
		});

		wrapper.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
			if (e.target.closest('.wpml-ls-statics-shortcode_actions')) return;
			e.preventDefault();
			e.stopPropagation();
			wrapper.classList.toggle('active');
		});

		document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
			if (!wrapper.contains(e.target)) {
				wrapper.classList.remove('active');
			}
		});
	}

	function run() {
		initBannerDropdown();
		if (document.cookie.indexOf('location-accepted') >= 0) return;

		var closeBtn = document.querySelector('.ls-close-button');
		if (closeBtn) {
			closeBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
				document.cookie = 'location-accepted=true; expires=Fri, 31 Dec 9999 23:59:59 GMT';
			});
		}

		var callbackName = '__ipinfo_cb_' + Date.now();
		var script = document.createElement('script');
		window[callbackName] = function(data) {
			clearTimeout(timeoutId);
			onIpInfoResponse(data);
			delete window[callbackName];
			if (script.parentNode) script.parentNode.removeChild(script);
		};
		var timeoutId = setTimeout(function() {
			if (window[callbackName]) {
				delete window[callbackName];
				if (script.parentNode) script.parentNode.removeChild(script);
			}
		}, 8000);
		script.src = 'https://ipinfo.io/?callback=' + callbackName; console.log('https://ipinfo.io/?callback=' + callbackName);
		document.head.appendChild(script);
	}

	if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
		document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', run);
	} else {
		run();
	}
})();
</script>

  /*

  .section-title .text-rotation {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  position: relative;
  width: 100%;
  height: 1.45em;
  padding-inline: 0.35em;
  margin-bottom: 0.15em;

  /*
   * "that work." appears on its own line and aligns

  .section-title .text-remainder, .scrolling-text.section-media-aside .section-pretitle, .scrolling-text .section-text p, .scrolling-text .section-cta-wrap {
    display: block;

  }

  /*
   * Text layers added by JavaScript
   */
  .text-rotation__item {
  position: absolute;
  top: 50%;
  left: 0.35em;
  right: 0.35em;

  display: block;
  white-space: nowrap;

  opacity: 1;
  transform: translateY(-50%);

    transition:
      transform 550ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
      opacity 400ms ease;
  }

  /*
   * Upcoming text begins below the visible box.
   */
  .text-rotation__item--next {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(65%);
  }

  /*
   * Move the current phrase upward.
   */
  .text-rotation.is-rotating .text-rotation__item--current {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(-165%);
  }

  /*
   * Move the next phrase into the center.
   */
  .text-rotation.is-rotating .text-rotation__item--next {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translateY(-50%);
  }

  /*
   * Disable transitions while resetting the text layers.
   */
  .text-rotation.is-resetting .text-rotation__item {
    transition: none;
  }

      border-radius: 10px;
    }
  }

      transition: none;
    }
  }

      display: flex;

      animation: none !important;
      transition: none !important;

<script type="text/rocketlazyloadscript">
  (function () {
    const phrases = [
      "Training videos",
      "Step-by-step guides",
      "Software demos",
      "Explainer videos",
      "Tutorials",
      "How-to guides",
      "Onboarding videos",
      "Company shareouts"
    ];

    const rotationInterval = 2000;
    const animationDuration = 550;

    function initializeTextRotators() {
      const reducedMotion = window.matchMedia(
        "(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)"
      ).matches;

      /*
       * Disable the animation on screens 420px wide or smaller.
       * Change 420px if you want a different breakpoint.
       */
      const verySmallScreen = window.matchMedia(
        "(max-width: 420px)"
      ).matches;

      document
        .querySelectorAll(".text-rotation")
        .forEach(function (rotator) {
          if (rotator.dataset.rotationReady === "true") {
            return;
          }

          const heading = rotator.closest("h1");

          const remainder = heading
            ? heading.querySelector(".text-remainder")
            : null;

          const remainderText = remainder
            ? remainder.textContent.trim()
            : "that work.";

          /*
           * Give screen readers one stable version
           * of the heading.
           */
          if (
            heading &&
            !heading.hasAttribute("aria-label")
          ) {
            heading.setAttribute(
              "aria-label",
              phrases[0] + " " + remainderText
            );
          }

          rotator.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");

          /*
           * Show only the first phrase when:
           *
           * 1. Reduced motion is enabled, or
           * 2. The screen is 420px wide or smaller.
           */
          if (reducedMotion || verySmallScreen) {
            rotator.textContent = phrases[0];
            rotator.dataset.rotationReady = "true";
            rotator.classList.add("rotation-disabled");
            return;
          }

          let currentIndex = 0;
          let isAnimating = false;

          const currentItem =
            document.createElement("span");

          currentItem.className =
            "text-rotation__item " +
            "text-rotation__item--current";

          currentItem.textContent =
            phrases[currentIndex];

          const nextItem =
            document.createElement("span");

          nextItem.className =
            "text-rotation__item " +
            "text-rotation__item--next";

          nextItem.textContent =
            phrases[
              (currentIndex + 1) % phrases.length
            ];

          rotator.replaceChildren(
            currentItem,
            nextItem
          );

          rotator.dataset.rotationReady = "true";

          window.setInterval(function () {
            if (isAnimating || document.hidden) {
              return;
            }

            isAnimating = true;

            const nextIndex =
              (currentIndex + 1) % phrases.length;

            nextItem.textContent =
              phrases[nextIndex];

            rotator.classList.add("is-rotating");

            window.setTimeout(function () {
              currentIndex = nextIndex;

              rotator.classList.add("is-resetting");

              currentItem.textContent =
                phrases[currentIndex];

              nextItem.textContent =
                phrases[
                  (currentIndex + 1) %
                  phrases.length
                ];

              rotator.classList.remove(
                "is-rotating"
              );

              void rotator.offsetWidth;

              rotator.classList.remove(
                "is-resetting"
              );

              isAnimating = false;
            }, animationDuration);
          }, rotationInterval);
        });
    }

    if (document.readyState === "loading") {
      document.addEventListener(
        "DOMContentLoaded",
        initializeTextRotators
      );
    } else {
      initializeTextRotators();
    }
  })();
</script>

			// User info - fetched from API and cached in localStorage
			(function() {
				// Get the current domain for API URL
				const currentDomain = window.location.origin;

				const statusUrl = currentDomain + '/api/v/1/profile/info/';
                				
				// Cache key and TTL (12 hours)
				const CACHE_KEY = 'tsc_user_profile_data';
				const CACHE_TTL = 12 * 60 * 60 * 1000; // 12 hours in milliseconds

				function hasValidProfileData(data) {
					return data && data.techSmithId;
				}

				async function fetchProfileFromApi() {
					const response = await fetch(statusUrl, {
						credentials: 'include',
						mode: 'cors'
					});

					let data;
					try {
						data = await response.json();
					} catch (e) {
						throw new Error('API request failed: invalid JSON');
					}

					if (!response.ok) {
						console.warn('Profile API returned ' + response.status, data);
						return data || null;
					}

					return data;
				}

				async function getUserProfileData(retryCount = 0) {
					try {
						// Check localStorage cache first (only use cache if it has valid profile data)
						const cached = localStorage.getItem(CACHE_KEY);
						if (cached) {
							const { data, timestamp } = JSON.parse(cached);
							const now = Date.now();
							if (now - timestamp < CACHE_TTL && hasValidProfileData(data)) {
								return data;
							}
						}

						const data = await fetchProfileFromApi();
						if (data === null) return null;
						
						// If user logged out, clear cache
						if (data && data.SignedIn === false) {
							localStorage.removeItem(CACHE_KEY);
							return data;
						}

						// Only cache when we have meaningful profile data (avoids caching empty response right after login)
						if (hasValidProfileData(data)) {
							localStorage.setItem(CACHE_KEY, JSON.stringify({
								data: data,
								timestamp: Date.now()
							}));
							return data;
						}

						// Profile not ready yet (e.g. right after login): retry once after a short delay
						if (retryCount === 0) {
							await new Promise(function(r) { setTimeout(r, 1500); });
							return getUserProfileData(1);
						}

						return data;
					} catch (error) {
						console.error('Error fetching user profile data:', error);
						return null;
					}

(function() {
	var translatedLangs = {"en":"https:\/\/www.techsmith.com\/","de":"https:\/\/www.techsmith.de\/","fr":"https:\/\/www.techsmith.fr\/","es":"https:\/\/www.techsmith.es\/","ja":"https:\/\/www.techsmith.co.jp\/","pt-br":"https:\/\/www.techsmith.pt\/"};
	var availableTranslations = {"de":"true","en":"true","es":"true","fr":"true","ja":"true"};
	var currentLanguage = "en";

	var supportedCountries = ["ES", "FR", "DE", "PT", "JA", "MX", "AR", "CO", "CL", "PE", "VE", "EC", "GT", "CU", "BO", "DO", "HN", "PY", "SV", "NI", "CR", "UY", "PA", "GQ", "AO", "MZ", "GW", "TL", "CV", "ST"];
	var spanishCountries = ["ES", "MX", "AR", "CO", "CL", "PE", "VE", "EC", "GT", "CU", "BO", "DO", "HN", "PY", "SV", "NI", "CR", "UY", "PA", "GQ"];
	var portugueseCountries = ["PT", "BR", "AO", "MZ", "GW", "TL", "CV", "ST"];

	function applyBanner(linkUrl, linkText) {
		var sw = document.querySelector('.language-switcher');
		var link = document.querySelector('.language-switcher .language-link');
		if (!sw || !link) return;
		link.setAttribute('href', linkUrl);
		link.textContent = linkText;
		sw.style.display = '';
		var header = document.querySelector('.tsc-header-wrapper-redesign');
		if (header && sw.offsetHeight) {
			header.style.top = sw.offsetHeight + 'px';
		}
	}

	function onIpInfoResponse(response) { console.log(response);
		var link = document.querySelector('.language-switcher .language-link');
		var sw = document.querySelector('.language-switcher');
		if (!link || !sw) return;

		var country = response && response.country;
		if (!country) { 
			console.log('no country'); 
			return; 
		}

		// Show banner when user's country matches a language and they're not already viewing that language.
		// Only require a target URL (translatedLangs); allow linking to language root if current page has no translation.
		if (spanishCountries.indexOf(country) !== -1 && currentLanguage !== 'es' && translatedLangs['es']) {
			applyBanner(translatedLangs['es'], 'Spanish');
		} else if (country === 'FR' && currentLanguage !== 'fr' && translatedLangs['fr']) {
			applyBanner(translatedLangs['fr'], 'French');
		} else if (country === 'DE' && currentLanguage !== 'de' && translatedLangs['de']) {
			applyBanner(translatedLangs['de'], 'German');
		} else if (portugueseCountries.indexOf(country) !== -1 && currentLanguage !== 'pt' && translatedLangs['pt-br']) {
			applyBanner(translatedLangs['pt-br'], 'Portuguese');
		} else if (country === 'JP' && currentLanguage !== 'ja' && translatedLangs['ja']) {
			applyBanner(translatedLangs['ja'], 'Japanese');
		} else if (currentLanguage !== 'en' && supportedCountries.indexOf(country) === -1 && translatedLangs['en']) {
			applyBanner(translatedLangs['en'], 'English');
		}
	}

	function initBannerDropdown() {
		var wrapper = document.querySelector('.language-switcher .tsc-dropdown-menu-wrapper');
		var trigger = document.querySelector('.language-switcher .tsc-dropdown-menu-trigger');
		if (!wrapper || !trigger || wrapper.dataset.dropdownBound === 'true') return;

		wrapper.dataset.dropdownBound = 'true';

		trigger.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
			e.preventDefault();
			e.stopPropagation();
			wrapper.classList.toggle('active');
		});

		wrapper.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
			if (e.target.closest('.wpml-ls-statics-shortcode_actions')) return;
			e.preventDefault();
			e.stopPropagation();
			wrapper.classList.toggle('active');
		});

		document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
			if (!wrapper.contains(e.target)) {
				wrapper.classList.remove('active');
			}
		});
	}

	function run() {
		initBannerDropdown();
		if (document.cookie.indexOf('location-accepted') >= 0) return;

		var closeBtn = document.querySelector('.ls-close-button');
		if (closeBtn) {
			closeBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
				document.cookie = 'location-accepted=true; expires=Fri, 31 Dec 9999 23:59:59 GMT';
			});
		}

		var callbackName = '__ipinfo_cb_' + Date.now();
		var script = document.createElement('script');
		window[callbackName] = function(data) {
			clearTimeout(timeoutId);
			onIpInfoResponse(data);
			delete window[callbackName];
			if (script.parentNode) script.parentNode.removeChild(script);
		};
		var timeoutId = setTimeout(function() {
			if (window[callbackName]) {
				delete window[callbackName];
				if (script.parentNode) script.parentNode.removeChild(script);
			}
		}, 8000);
		script.src = 'https://ipinfo.io/?callback=' + callbackName; console.log('https://ipinfo.io/?callback=' + callbackName);
		document.head.appendChild(script);
	}

	if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
		document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', run);
	} else {
		run();
	}
})();
</script>

			// User info - fetched from API and cached in localStorage
			(function() {
				// Get the current domain for API URL
				const currentDomain = window.location.origin;

				const statusUrl = currentDomain + '/api/v/1/profile/info/';
                				
				// Cache key and TTL (12 hours)
				const CACHE_KEY = 'tsc_user_profile_data';
				const CACHE_TTL = 12 * 60 * 60 * 1000; // 12 hours in milliseconds

				function hasValidProfileData(data) {
					return data && data.techSmithId;
				}

				async function fetchProfileFromApi() {
					const response = await fetch(statusUrl, {
						credentials: 'include',
						mode: 'cors'
					});

					let data;
					try {
						data = await response.json();
					} catch (e) {
						throw new Error('API request failed: invalid JSON');
					}

					if (!response.ok) {
						console.warn('Profile API returned ' + response.status, data);
						return data || null;
					}

					return data;
				}

				async function getUserProfileData(retryCount = 0) {
					try {
						// Check localStorage cache first (only use cache if it has valid profile data)
						const cached = localStorage.getItem(CACHE_KEY);
						if (cached) {
							const { data, timestamp } = JSON.parse(cached);
							const now = Date.now();
							if (now - timestamp < CACHE_TTL && hasValidProfileData(data)) {
								return data;
							}
						}

						const data = await fetchProfileFromApi();
						if (data === null) return null;
						
						// If user logged out, clear cache
						if (data && data.SignedIn === false) {
							localStorage.removeItem(CACHE_KEY);
							return data;
						}

						// Only cache when we have meaningful profile data (avoids caching empty response right after login)
						if (hasValidProfileData(data)) {
							localStorage.setItem(CACHE_KEY, JSON.stringify({
								data: data,
								timestamp: Date.now()
							}));
							return data;
						}

						// Profile not ready yet (e.g. right after login): retry once after a short delay
						if (retryCount === 0) {
							await new Promise(function(r) { setTimeout(r, 1500); });
							return getUserProfileData(1);
						}

						return data;
					} catch (error) {
						console.error('Error fetching user profile data:', error);
						return null;
					}
				}
				
				// Detect sign-out link clicks and clear cache
				function setupSignOutDetection() {
					// Use event delegation to catch dynamically added sign-out links
					document.addEventListener('click', async function(e) {
						const signOutLink = e.target.closest('.sign-out-link-2');
						if (signOutLink) {
							// Prevent default navigation so we can clear cache first
							e.preventDefault();
							e.stopPropagation();
							
							// Clear cache synchronously (localStorage.removeItem is synchronous)
							localStorage.removeItem(CACHE_KEY);
							console.log('Cache cleared:', CACHE_KEY);
							
							// Now navigate to sign-out URL
							const signOutUrl = signOutLink.getAttribute('href');
							if (signOutUrl) {
								window.location.href = signOutUrl;
							}
						}
					});
				}
               				
				// Setup sign-out detection
				setupSignOutDetection();

					const profileData = await getUserProfileData(); console.log('profileData raw:', profileData);

					// Build dataLayer object with only non-empty values
					const userDataLayer = {};

					// If user is signed in and we have profile data
					if (profileData && profileData.techSmithId) {
                        
						// Get TechSmithId (user_id)
						if (profileData.techSmithId) {
							userDataLayer.user_id = profileData.techSmithId;
						}
						
						// Get hashed email
						if (profileData.hashedEmail) {
							userDataLayer.user_email = profileData.hashedEmail;
						}

                        // Get hashed first name
                        if (profileData.hashedFirstName) {
							userDataLayer.first_name = profileData.hashedFirstName;
						}

                        // Get hashed last name
                        if (profileData.hashedLastName) {
							userDataLayer.last_name = profileData.hashedLastName;
						}
					}

					// Only push to dataLayer if we have at least one value
					if (Object.keys(userDataLayer).length > 0) {
						window.dataLayer = window.dataLayer || [];
						dataLayer.push(userDataLayer);
					}

                    console.log(userDataLayer);
				}

				// Execute the function
				pushUserDataToDataLayer();
			})();

	function applyBanner(linkUrl, linkText) {
		var sw = document.querySelector('.language-switcher');
		var link = document.querySelector('.language-switcher .language-link');
		if (!sw || !link) return;
		link.setAttribute('href', linkUrl);

	function onIpInfoResponse(response) { console.log(response);
		var link = document.querySelector('.language-switcher .language-link');
		var sw = document.querySelector('.language-switcher');
		if (!link || !sw) return;

		var country = response && response.country;

		if (spanishCountries.indexOf(country) !== -1 && currentLanguage !== 'es' && translatedLangs['es']) {

		} else if (country === 'FR' && currentLanguage !== 'fr' && translatedLangs['fr']) {
			applyBanner(translatedLangs['fr'], 'French');
		} else if (country === 'DE' && currentLanguage !== 'de' && translatedLangs['de']) {
			applyBanner(translatedLangs['de'], 'German');
		} else if (portugueseCountries.indexOf(country) !== -1 && currentLanguage !== 'pt' && translatedLangs['pt-br']) {
			applyBanner(translatedLangs['pt-br'], 'Portuguese');
		} else if (country === 'JP' && currentLanguage !== 'ja' && translatedLangs['ja']) {
			applyBanner(translatedLangs['ja'], 'Japanese');
		} else if (currentLanguage !== 'en' && supportedCountries.indexOf(country) === -1 && translatedLangs['en']) {

		var wrapper = document.querySelector('.language-switcher .tsc-dropdown-menu-wrapper');

			e.preventDefault();
			e.stopPropagation();

			e.stopPropagation();
			wrapper.classList.toggle('active');
		});

			if (!wrapper.contains(e.target)) {
				wrapper.classList.remove('active');
			}
		});

	}

		document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', run);
	} else {
		run();
	}
})();
